overview_description.description: Jordan Kuwait Bank operates as a commercial banking institution within the financial services sector. The organization provides personal, corporate, and private banking services to individual and commercial clients. It offers deposit accounts, including current accounts, savings plans, and fixed-term deposits. The business delivers personal financing, residential mortgage loans, auto loans, and commercial credit facilities. It issues credit cards, debit cards, and prepaid payment products under international payment networks.

about_short_description.short_description: Jordan Kuwait Bank is a Jordanian public shareholding company, offers employees in public & private sector loans to cover personal needs.

product.name: Current Account
product.description: A bank account allowing individuals and businesses to manage funds, issue cheques, and access electronic services with a minimum balance requirement.

product.name: Savings Account
product.description: An account designed for individuals to save money with interest, offering flexibility in deposits and withdrawals, and access to electronic services.

product.name: Personal Loan
product.description: A loan product offering financing up to 75,000 JOD with competitive interest rates and a repayment period of up to 8 years.

product.name: ATM Cash Order (ACO) Service
product.description: A service allowing users to send money to themselves or others for collection at any Jordan Kuwait Bank ATM without a card.

product.name: E-FAWATEERcom
product.description: An electronic bill payment service enabling users to view and pay bills from various sectors through bank branches and online services.

product.name: Overdraft Facilities
product.description: A service providing clients with the ability to withdraw more than their account balance within an agreed limit and time frame.
